messages:
sam: Following the all-hands Q&A, quick thread to capture concrete customer win/loss signals + what leadership should action. Short and actionable please.

leah: Sales summary: 3 losses this quarter where buyers pulled because we couldn't guarantee EU-only hosting for private deployments. Two cited long networking timelines; one jumped to a vendor with a managed VPC connector.

yasmin: CS: wins = low latency in-hosted path + transparent per-route metrics. Customers repeatedly said our latency SLOs + token cost breakdown in console sealed deals.

chao: Eng note: common ask = clearer sample infra. Right now customers try to piece together VPC peering + customer NATs. A single terraform module and a short checklist would cut onboarding time.

leah: Also asked for a short trust checklist for security teams: KMS options, SOC2/ISO pointers, how audit logs are exported. Needs to be 1 page.

tom: Product: can we prioritize a private quickstart + security 1-pager. Proposed scope: (A) terraform module + diagram, (B) step-by-step network checklist, (C) example HSM/KMS integration notes.

chao: I can prep a terraform scaffold. Example quick snippet customers liked in past: 
```hcl
module "redwood_private" {
  source = "git::https://internal.git/redwood/terraform-modules//private-deploy"
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  subnet_ids = var.subnet_ids
}
```
Will add comments for security groups and NAT options.

yasmin: Customer ask: embedding cost transparency. They want sample calc for 10M embedding calls/month with batching + 16-bit quantization options. A simple spreadsheet or calculator widget would help renewals.

leah: For renewals team: we need collateral in ~3 weeks for a big AE renewal. One-pager + cost example + sample quickstart link would be ideal.

sam: Proposed owners/times: private quickstart (Chao + DevEx) - 3 weeks; security 1-pager (Tom + Yasmin) - 2 weeks; embedding cost calc (Product + Finance) - 2 weeks. Anything else?

chao: Add: clearer behavior for model fallbacks during capacity constraints. Customers told us they'd rather fail fast than degrade silently. Need a config flag + audit events.

tom: Good call. We can add a "fallback_policy" flag and expose a fallback log stream in the console. P0-ish for enterprise.

leah: Sales also requested short benchmarking artifacts: one-pagers showing p50/p95/p99 for common prompt lengths on host vs dedicated. Helps infra buyers.

yasmin: I'll pull direct customer quotes and anonymized excerpts into the security doc. Also can add a checklist for compliance reviewers.

ops-bot: New ticket created: #AH-4521 "All-hands followup: private quickstart + security one-pager + embedding cost calc" assigned to chao, tom. Link: https://issues.internal/AH-4521

sam: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate action items in GH and ping owners. Please drop any short customer quotes here (1-2 lines) or DM me.
